Reason: The chest X-ray shows a characteristic curvilinear opacity (indicated by the arrow) descending along the right heart border, which represents the anomalous pulmonary vein draining into the inferior vena cava, resembling a scimitar sword. This finding, often accompanied by right lung hypoplasia and mediastinal shift, is pathognomonic for scimitar syndrome.
